sources_note: Primary source: sources/shift/ (on-site static HTML snapshot of shiftatmidnightwiki.site, 52 pages, synced from Jellyfish926/shift-at-midnight-wiki, sha 732bb7a). Every fact below was read directly off a page in that snapshot; nothing here was inferred, estimated, or pulled from outside sources not already cited BY the site itself. Where a page cites a first-party or outlet source with a URL (Steam, KeenGamer, DualShockers, Destructoid, TheGamer, AllThings.How, GameRant, SteamDB, the developer's own X account), that URL is used as source_url. Where a fact is the wiki's own editorial synthesis with no external citation (e.g. the 'seven threats' grouping, the glossary term count), source_tier: 'onsite' is set and only the wiki's own page(s) are cited. Steam AppID (3722330) and demo AppID (4050060) were both read directly from on-site content (index.html, demo/), never guessed. No Steam API calls were made in this pass; all Steam stats used here are the wiki's own citations of Steam's public pages, already present on-site. Where the site's own pages disagree (two different numbers, two different claims), BOTH values are kept with their own sources rather than one being chosen as correct; see each entity's unverified_fields. No 'code' (redemption code) entities exist in this file: the site explicitly states there is no redemption-code system at all. Only the 5 of 47 reported named doppelgangers that the site itself documents are included; no weapon list and no night-by-night shift schedule exist on this wiki, so none are built here either.

mech-night-shift-system.summary_en: Story Mode runs 13 procedurally generated shifts to a conclusion. No fixed per-night monster schedule is published or verifiable on this wiki; only three beats are fixed across every run.
mech-night-shift-system.generation_en: Procedurally generated, not level-based — two players on the same numbered shift report different events. No night-by-night table exists on this wiki by policy.
fixed_beats_en: Shift 9: the music box (Jack-in-the-Box) beat turns on; a N.E.T. email warns the player.
After Shift 12: the Sheriff Clyde decision, which (with the Shift-13 savings check) determines which of the 3 endings the run gets.
Shift 13: the final shift; The Dentist appears, and this is where the money threshold is checked.
mech-night-shift-system.blood_moon_en: A guaranteed-Hunt shift: blood rain falls and the Entity comes regardless of how well the player did at the counter.

mech-doppelganger-tells.summary_en: The seven categories of contradiction that can expose a doppelganger, per TheGamer, as compiled by this wiki's doppelganger identification guide.
categories_en: Name or personal details do not match the ID (strongest form: the database reports the real person is dead)
Habits or purchases do not line up with the file
Appearance or clothing contradicts the file (e.g. scar placement)
The emotion readout does not match the words
The plate does not match the vehicle's registered owner
document_first_checks_en: Does the ID have a barcode at all?
Put passports and driving licences through the computer instead of eyeballing them
Interrogate against the document (date of birth, occupation, photo vs. person)
unverified_fields: name_zh (no Chinese-language source exists anywhere in sources/shift/; English name used as-is, matching data/valheim/entities.json's precedent for untranslated names)

mech-counter-toolkit.summary_en: The five checks the player's job gives them at the counter to identify doppelgangers. Not tracked by the game itself.
tools_en: ID scan (answers exactly one question: is this document what it claims to be?)
N.E.T. database search by hand (no document required)
Description box on each file (registered appearance, occupation, personal details, shopping habits)
Vehicle and plate records (a later unlock; the only check outside the building)
unverified_fields: name_zh (no Chinese-language source exists anywhere in sources/shift/; English name used as-is, matching data/valheim/entities.json's precedent for untranslated names)

mech-itchio-prototype.summary_en: The free, single-player itch.io build the game started as, before the Steam multiplayer demo or the full release existed.
mech-itchio-prototype.rating_count_task_brief_note_en: This dataset's brief flagged a possible 365-vs-360 split for this figure. After reading credits/ and demo/ in full, and grepping the entire on-site snapshot for '365', this wiki's snapshot states 360 in two independent places (credits/ and demo/) and never states 365 anywhere. Recorded as 360; the 365 variant was not reproducible in this snapshot.
mech-itchio-prototype.relation_to_full_game_en: Predecessor prototype; co-op was added later, on the way to the Steam multiplayer demo, and was not present in this original single-player build.
